display_information.name: CaseStudyBot
display_information.description: Surfaces the right X creative strategy case studies from the master Drive folder
display_information.long_description: Tag @CaseStudyBot with a brand, vertical, product/strategy, or cultural moment and it returns 3-5 case study decks (exact title + Google Drive link) from the Creative Strategy master folder. Example: @CaseStudyBot Trend Genius case study for the CPG vertical.
